method: Re-read the merged Compare/logo maintenance authority and permanent logo-disposition operating spec before review.
Re-check each of the exact 21 baseline fallback records against current or preserved first-party product/site/docs/repository material.
Treat existence of imagery as insufficient unless the mark is attributable to the stablecoin/product and a source asset can be pinned under the provenance contract.
Do not promote issuer, protocol/project, corporate favicon, or directory artwork as a token mark without asset-specific attribution.
Do not modify public mappings or vendor image files during Phase B.

records.name: Acala Dollar / aUSD Seed
records.identity_basis: Acala official documentation binds aUSD to aSEED and points to aSEED brand assets.
records.evidence: The linked media-kit target resolves to the generic Acala Brand Assets package rather than a pinned aSEED-specific file. The currently vendored mark is an Acala project mark, so the display fallback remains required.

records.name: Avalon USDa
records.identity_basis: Avalon official product/docs material identifies USDa as the protocol's flagship dollar asset.
records.evidence: A media-kit path exists, but the re-audit did not recover a pinned USDa-specific logo asset distinct from Avalon project branding. Preserve the neutral monogram rather than reuse the generic project icon.

records.name: Bison Bank Electronic Money Token — Euro
records.identity_basis: Bison Bank's EUB product page and launch material explicitly identify EUB as the EUR-backed Bison Bank Electronic Money Token.
records.evidence: The current product page exposes product imagery but no separately attributable EUB token mark was recovered. Do not substitute the Bison Bank issuer identity.

records.name: Bison Bank Electronic Money Token — US Dollar
records.identity_basis: Bison Bank's USB product page and launch material explicitly identify USB as the USD-backed Bison Bank Electronic Money Token.
records.evidence: The current product page exposes product imagery but no separately attributable USB token mark was recovered. Do not substitute the Bison Bank issuer identity.

records.name: Brazilian Digital Token
records.identity_basis: Transfero's current BRZ page identifies BRZ, its supported networks, and canonical contracts; Transfero stablecoin material also labels BRZ imagery as BRZ.
records.evidence: Asset-specific imagery is visible in first-party material, but the re-audit could not pin a stable source file suitable for the local provenance contract. The existing vendored Transfero/project icon therefore remains non-display research evidence.

records.name: AllUnity CHF
records.identity_basis: AllUnity's product page identifies CHFAU and AllUnity publishes a general AllUnity logo pack.
records.evidence: The available logo pack is presented as AllUnity branding and no separately pinned CHFAU-specific mark was recovered. Preserve fallback rather than treat the issuer logo as the token logo.

records.name: PHPC
records.identity_basis: Coins.ph first-party PHPC material identifies the PHP-denominated stablecoin.
records.evidence: No pinned PHPC-specific logo file was recovered; the prior local image is the Coins.ph site/issuer icon. Preserve neutral fallback.

records.name: Dynamic Set Dollar
records.identity_basis: The official DSD repository identifies Dynamic Set Dollar and its canonical deployment.
records.evidence: The historical token-logo URL recorded in prior research is unavailable and the retained GitHub organization avatar is project-level only. Current dsd.finance content is not trusted as new provenance because unrelated injected content was observed during re-audit.

records.name: EURAU
records.identity_basis: AllUnity's product and launch material identifies EURAU and AllUnity publishes a general AllUnity logo pack.
records.evidence: No separately pinned EURAU-specific mark was recovered from the current first-party brand material. The generic AllUnity mark remains issuer-level only.

records.name: Quantoz GBPQ
records.identity_basis: Quantoz current marketing material identifies GBPQ and publishes the exact Ethereum Token ID.
records.evidence: Quantoz exposes a corporate Logo Kit, but the re-audit did not recover a separately attributable GBPQ token mark. Preserve fallback rather than use the Quantoz favicon/logo.

records.name: MNEE
records.identity_basis: The official MNEE stablecoin homepage directly labels the linked asset as 'MNEE Logo'.
records.evidence: This cures the old PR #498 gap: the first-party product itself now exposes a product-specific SVG rather than only issuer identity.

records.name: Quantoz PLNQ
records.identity_basis: Quantoz current marketing material identifies PLNQ and publishes the exact Ethereum Token ID.
records.evidence: Quantoz exposes a corporate Logo Kit, but the re-audit did not recover a separately attributable PLNQ token mark. Preserve fallback rather than use the Quantoz favicon/logo.

records.name: poundtoken
records.identity_basis: Historical first-party poundtoken material explicitly labels an image as '1GBP logo black', while the existing local image came from a contract-checked directory record.
records.evidence: The product-specific branding lead is real, but a stable first-party source asset file could not be pinned in this review and the live domain now contains unrelated later content. Retain fallback instead of laundering the directory image into a direct logo.

records.name: AllUnity SEK
records.identity_basis: AllUnity's product/launch material identifies SEKAU and AllUnity publishes a general AllUnity logo pack.
records.evidence: No separately pinned SEKAU-specific mark was recovered. The shared AllUnity icon remains issuer branding only.

records.name: SoFiUSD
records.identity_basis: SoFi's dedicated product page and investor release identify SoFiUSD/SOFID.
records.evidence: First-party pages contain SoFiUSD product graphics, but the retrievable press/logo asset is the corporate SoFi mark rather than a standalone SOFID token mark. Preserve fallback.

records.name: USDGO
records.identity_basis: Anchorage Digital's USDGO reserve-attestation page identifies USDGO as OSL Group's stablecoin and links a dedicated image with alt text 'USDGO'.
records.evidence: A stablecoin-specific SVG is directly attached to the official USDGO transparency page, distinct from the separately labelled OSL corporate logo on the same page.

records.name: USDH
records.identity_basis: Native Markets/Bridge first-party USDH material explicitly identifies USDH and refers to USDH brand assets.
records.evidence: The asset clearly has its own branding, but the current site is sunset, a stable source file was not pinned, and the first-party terms restrict reproduction/use of site logos and images without permission. Under the local provenance/use contract, keep the neutral fallback.

records.name: Ondo US Dollar Yield
records.identity_basis: Ondo's dedicated USDY page identifies the product and exact network deployments and links an Ondo media kit.
records.evidence: The page's directly recoverable logo is the Ondo corporate mark; the re-audit did not pin a separate USDY token mark from first-party media assets. Preserve fallback.

records.name: Kujira USK
records.identity_basis: Kujira first-party material identifies USK as the ecosystem stablecoin.
records.evidence: The previously vendored source is the Kujira project icon and no separately pinned USK product mark was recovered. Preserve fallback.

records.name: Resolv USD
records.identity_basis: Resolv's official Brand Kit separates RLP, USR, stUSR, wstUSR, RESOLV, and stRESOLV and provides a dedicated image directly under the USR label.
records.evidence: The dedicated USR brand-kit asset is asset-specific and distinct from the generic Resolv project mark previously vendored.

records.name: VNX Swiss Franc
records.identity_basis: VNX current first-party material explicitly identifies VCHF among its fiat-referencing tokens and current supported networks.
records.evidence: No separately pinned VCHF-specific mark was recovered; the prior local asset is the generic VNX site icon. Preserve fallback.
